---
title: "Steam Game Analysis Environment Check"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
source("../R/db_connect.R")
counts <- with_steam_db(function(con) {
  counts <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
    con,
    paste(
      "SELECT",
      "(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM games) AS games,",
      "(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_snapshots) AS review_snapshots,",
      "(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vw_model_sample_20) AS model_sample"
    )
  )
  stopifnot(
    counts$games[[1]] == 3000,
    counts$review_snapshots[[1]] == 3000,
    counts$model_sample[[1]] == 844
  )
  counts
})
counts
```
